resultado.vazio: Set the parameters and calculate to see the incident energy, the arc flash boundary and the PPE category.

intro.texto: Let's simulate a real-world situation. Under the new NR-10 (2026), Brazil's electrical safety standard, a more rigorous analysis of the arc flash hazard is now required.
intro.investigar: Let's investigate to prevent this kind of accident
intro.vestimentaTexto: The accident shows the danger of working without proper clothing. Now we will correctly select the arc flash protective clothing (PPE) for this scenario by calculating the incident energy and the hazard category.

etiqueta.rodape: Caution: changes to the equipment or the system configuration invalidate the calculations and the required PPE · IEEE 1584 / NBR 17227

n1: FR clothing ≥ 4 cal/cm² (shirt + pants or coverall)
n2: FR clothing ≥ 8 cal/cm² (shirt + pants or coverall)
Face shield with Class E visor
Rubber insulating gloves with leather protectors
n3: FR suit ≥ 25 cal/cm² + arc flash hood
Rubber insulating gloves with leather protectors
n4: FR suit ≥ 40 cal/cm² + arc flash hood
Hard hat + full arc flash hood
Rubber insulating gloves with leather protectors
n5: Redesign the protection to reduce IE < 40 cal/cm²
Apply mitigation techniques (arc flash relay, ZSI)
